ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The main body in the figure is a steroid-like fused tetracyclic skeleton; the lower-left six-membered ring contains a ketone carbonyl and forms an enone fragment with the adjacent C=C; on the upper ring there is an HO substituent represented by a solid wedge bond; on the upper right side there is an acetate/acetoxy substituent labeled OAc, whose carbonyl belongs to this acetate fragment; angular methyl groups and stereochemistry marked by multiple wedge and dashed bonds can also be seen on the skeleton. An O=N–Cl fragment and curved arrows are drawn at the upper left; according to the problem statement, ignore the curved arrows and only transcribe the static structural connectivity. Reasoning transcription: write from the acetate end as CC(=O)O, and connect this oxygen to the chiral ring carbon bearing OAc, encoded as CC(=O)O[C@H]1; continue along the fused ring as [C@H]1CC[C@@]2, where this [C@@]2 is the tetrasubstituted bridgehead/connection center subsequently connected to Cl[N+](=O)[O-]. According to the wedge/dashed bonds in the figure, the branched ring system is encoded in order as [C@H]3CC[C@]4([C@H]2[C@H]1O), where [C@H]1O represents the chiral carbon bearing a hydroxyl group; then write in the left enone and angular methyl fragment CC=C5C(=O)CC[C@]45C. Finally connect the upper-left O=N–Cl fragment in charge-separated form as Cl[N+](=O)[O-]. Therefore the obtained isomeric SMILES is: CC(=O)O[C@H]1CC[C@@]2([C@H]3CC[C@]4([C@H]2[C@H]1O)CC=C5C(=O)CC[C@]45C)Cl[N+](=O)[O-].

raw_record.question_text: What is the SMILES expression of the transition-state structure shown in the image, ignoring the arrows?

method.method_draft: Ignore the curved arrows as instructed, then systematically transcribe the static structure. Start at the acetate methyl and carbonyl, connect through the ester oxygen to the chiral steroid carbon bearing the OAc group. Walk around the fused ring system, assigning ring-closure numbers for the cyclohexane/cyclopentane/steroid framework, inserting the right ketone carbonyl, the left enone carbonyl and C=C, and the angular methyl group. At each wedge/hash bond in the image, assign the corresponding [C@H], [C@@], or quaternary [C@]/[C@@] descriptor. Finally attach the depicted Cl–N(=O)O fragment to the appropriate bridgehead carbon as Cl[N+](=O)[O-]. Canonicalize or choose a valid isomeric SMILES matching the depicted stereochemistry, yielding the standard expression.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个甾体样四环骨架，左下环含一个酮羰基并与相邻 C=C 构成烯酮；右侧有五元环并带一个羰基；上方有一个 OAc 乙酸酯取代基；中上部有一个 HO 取代基；骨架上可见多个楔形/虚线键表示立体化学；左上方还画有 O=N–Cl 片段及弯箭头。按题意忽略弯箭头，只保留静态连接关系。推理转写：从乙酸酯端开始写作 CC(=O)O–，连接到带 OAc 的手性碳；随后沿甾体稠合环编号，保留图中羟基、右侧五元环羰基、左侧烯酮 C=C 和酮羰基、角甲基以及各桥头手性中心；最后把图中 Cl–N(=O)O 片段作为 Cl[N+](=O)[O-] 接到相应桥头碳上。由图示立体化学得到对应异构 SMILES。

method.CoT_after_polish_1: 图像描述：图中主体是一个甾体样稠合四环骨架，左下六元环含一个酮羰基并与相邻 C=C 构成烯酮片段；上部环上有一个以粗楔键表示的 HO 取代基；右上侧有一个标为 OAc 的乙酸酯/乙酰氧基取代基，其羰基属于该乙酸酯片段；骨架上还可见角甲基以及多处楔形、虚线键标示的立体化学。左上方画有 O=N–Cl 片段和弯箭头；按题意忽略弯箭头，只转写静态结构连接。推理转写：从乙酸酯端写为 CC(=O)O，并把该氧连接到带 OAc 的手性环碳，编码为 CC(=O)O[C@H]1；沿稠合环继续写作 [C@H]1CC[C@@]2，其中该 [C@@]2 是后续连接 Cl[N+](=O)[O-] 的四取代桥头/连接中心。按图中楔形/虚线键，分支环系依次编码为 [C@H]3CC[C@]4([C@H]2[C@H]1O)，其中 [C@H]1O 表示带羟基的手性碳；再写入左侧烯酮和角甲基片段 CC=C5C(=O)CC[C@]45C。最后将左上 O=N–Cl 片段以电荷分离形式接为 Cl[N+](=O)[O-]。因此得到的异构 SMILES 为：CC(=O)O[C@H]1CC[C@@]2([C@H]3CC[C@]4([C@H]2[C@H]1O)CC=C5C(=O)CC[C@]45C)Cl[N+](=O)[O-]。
